curl 8.21.0_7 Windows x64 Dependency Notices
=============================================

The official curl-for-win executable used by PrimeRL reports these statically
linked third-party libraries. Versions come from the upstream build page and
the executable's `--version` output:

- Brotli 1.2.0: `dependencies/brotli-LICENSE.txt`
- libpsl 0.23.2: `dependencies/libpsl-COPYING.txt`
- LibreSSL 4.3.2: `dependencies/libressl-COPYING.txt`
- libssh2 1.11.1: `dependencies/libssh2-COPYING.txt`
- nghttp2 1.70.0: `dependencies/nghttp2-COPYING.txt`
- nghttp3 1.18.0: `dependencies/nghttp3-COPYING.txt`
- ngtcp2 1.25.0: `dependencies/ngtcp2-COPYING.txt`
- Public Suffix List 2026-06-23: `dependencies/public-suffix-list-LICENSE.txt`
- zlib-ng 2.3.3: `dependencies/zlib-ng-LICENSE.md`
- zstd 1.5.7: `dependencies/zstd-LICENSE.txt`

Upstream build reference:
- https://curl.se/windows/
